analogy.rationale: Thyroid hormone receptors THRA/THRB are nuclear receptors, so the closest transcriptional analogs are other nuclear receptor ligands; however, these cell lines express little thyroid receptor and thyroid hormone stimulants typically elicit weak responses, so other nuclear receptor agonists are expected to share only modest similarity.
